looked: pixel comparison at 256 px of every pair of pictures whose 16×16 difference hash was within 4 bits, across different part numbers
findings: A maker that publishes one picture for several part numbers (cable lengths, screen sizes, tilt angles) has shown none of them exactly: each such picture is held for none of them.
A display sold with and without a transducer is the same display; its picture is held for both, and the one with a transducer says the transducer is not shown where it is not.
